integrity: The proof is self-contained from the k-rainbow total domination definition. The published complete-bipartite theorem is treated as prior coverage of the two-part slice rather than as evidence of novelty. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs and \(k\ge2\).
It determines the minimum weight but not the number or full structure of all minimum functions.
The exhaustive computation is finite corroboration; the infinite statement rests on the analytic proof.
An unindexed equivalent result under alternate notation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact \(k\)-rainbow total domination of complete multipartite graphs
